arStrings.szText: As am I. Thank you. And those people, they earned their death for what they tried to do.
Sanctuary may be covered in shadows but if we fight for it, there can still be Light.
I see myself in her. That’s why I’ll see her safely to the Wardens of Light. And if she chooses to stay…she’ll have a place among us.
